description: Search a Mandarin Chinese dictionary by Chinese characters, pinyin or an English word. Returns up to 10 matching words, each with its pinyin, a short meaning, its HSK level when it has one, and a link to its dictionary page. Use this when the user wants the Chinese for an English word, or does not know the exact headword. Do not use it for whole sentences (use segment_text) or grammar questions.

query.description: Chinese characters, pinyin (with or without tones) or English.

name: search_dictionary
title: Search the Chinese dictionary
